text: dsh-git-worktree 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web Client 的 Git Worktree 插件，为每项编码任务建立独立会话和工作目录，让 Agent 在隔离环境中修改代码。完成后可提交验收摘要和验证记录，在当前项目预览改动，再由用户确认保存、继续修改或放弃；长任务可保存阶段检查点并继续，交付后还能在原会话开启下一轮。插件提供 Worktree 列表、状态查看、恢复流程和侧栏任务界面，依赖 DSH 的 Git Workspace 与本机 Git。

dsh-git-worktree gives DSH Web agents isolated Git worktrees for coding tasks. Users review a summary, preview changes in the current project, then confirm delivery, resume editing, or discard the task. It supports checkpoints and later iterations. Requires a DSH Git Workspace and Git.
我想让每个编码任务在自己的 Git 工作目录里进行，别和当前项目的改动混在一起。
有没有办法先看 Agent 的改动，再决定要不要写回当前项目？
我希望长任务能保存阶段进度，之后在同一个隔离环境继续。
怎么让 Agent 完成后提交摘要和测试结果，留给我验收？
我想从 DSH 会话里查看关联的 Worktree 及其状态。
预览后我还想继续修改，怎样撤回这次预览并回到任务里？
I want each coding task to use its own Git working directory so parallel changes stay separate.
Can I review an agent's changes in my project before confirming delivery?
dsh-git-worktree 的功能「隔离任务会话」：模型调用 `worktree_create` 后，从 Local Session 创建独立的 Git Worktree 和目标 Session，并返回会话及目录信息。
dsh-git-worktree 的功能「验收报告」：Agent 提交摘要、变更文件、验证状态、测试记录和建议提交说明，形成 Ready for Review 卡片，等待用户处理。
dsh-git-worktree 的功能「本地预览与交付」：先计算变更计划并校验 Local 和 Worktree 状态，再把任务改动预览到当前项目；用户确认后完成本轮交付。
dsh-git-worktree 的功能「阶段检查点与迭代」：任务可在 Worktree 内保存阶段提交并继续，交付完成后也能在原 Session 开始下一轮修改。
dsh-git-worktree 的功能「Worktree 命令和列表」：通过 `/worktree` 查看状态、列出任务、继续修改、完成交付或放弃任务，并可按 Session 管理关联环境。
dsh-git-worktree 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web Client，并要求使用 Git Workspace；README 的安装示例仍是 0.12.0，而此提交的 package.json 版本为 0.12.1。

dsh-git-worktree README · dsh-git-worktree：`dsh-git-worktree` 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) 的 Git Worktree 插件。它为隔离任务创建独立的 Worktree（工作目录），Agent 的代码修改和测试在其中进行；只有你发起预览或确认保存时，插件才会把任务改动写回当前项目。任务完成后，你可以先预览结果，再选择保存、退回修改或放弃。

这套 Git Worktree 工作方式最初来自基于 Pi Agent Runtime 的开源桌面 coding 工作台 [Domi](https://github.com/restflux/domi)，本插件是针对 DeepSeek Harness 独立适配的版本，可以单独安装和使用。

[English](README.en.md) · [完整使用指南](docs/USAGE.md) · [架构说明](docs/WORKTREE-CONSOLE-ARCHITECTURE.md)

dsh-git-worktree README · 为什么使用它？：让 Agent 直接修改当前项目时，它的改动可能与你尚未提交的内容混在一起；同时运行多个任务时，也更容易互相影响。使用本插件后：

- 每个任务都在自己的 Git Worktree（独立工作目录）中修改和测试；
- 多个隔离任务可以同时开发，各自使用独立工作目录；同一项目一次只允许一个任务进入验收写回流程；
- Agent 完成后，你可以先把修改临时显示在当前项目中查看；
- 只有确认后才会保存本轮修改，遇到冲突时不会自动覆盖你的内容。

dsh-git-worktree README · 核心能力：- **Git Worktree 隔离**：每个任务都有独立的工作目录和 Agent 对话。
- **多个 Worktree 并行**：可以同时开发多个任务；为了避免混入修改，同一项目每次只验收一个任务。
- **提交前预览**：先在当前项目中查看真实效果，不会立即创建 Git 提交。
- **不满意可以退回**：撤回本次预览，继续让 Agent 修改，不影响其他本地改动。
- **只保存本轮任务**：确认后只提交这个任务的修改，不把无关内容一起带入。
- **长任务可分阶段**：先保存当前阶段的进度，再继续开发；最终仍合并为一次交付。
- **出错时保护现场**：检测到分支变化、内容冲突或中断时停止操作，保留现场供你处理。
- **集中查看任务**：同一项目的当前及历史 Worktree 会按 Host 导航归属聚合到侧边栏，归属不明确时保守保留原位置。
- **验收详情集中查看**：从验收条打开只读详情，查看文件列表、验证记录与版本信息，不必翻找聊天工具记录。
- **空仓库安全起步**：无提交仓库可在明确确认后创建不包含用户文件的空首次提交，再建立隔离 Worktree。
- **携带项目 Skills**：首次及下一轮 Worktree 创建时一次性携带 `.dsh/skills`、`.agents/skills` 和 `.claude/skills`，辅助文件与 Git 交付隔离。
- **原对话继续下一轮**：任务交付后，无需新开对话即可继续下一项修改。
dsh-git-worktree README · 核心能力：> 当前版本管理单个项目中的 Git Worktree，暂不提供跨项目的全局管理界面。

dsh-git-worktree README · 工作流：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[当前项目] -->|创建隔离任务| B[独立 Git Worktree]
    B --> C[Agent 修改并测试]
    C --> D[查看验收结果]

dsh-git-worktree README · 怎么选？：| 目标 | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| 先在当前项目中查看效果 | **预览修改** |
| 预览结果没有问题 | **确认并保存** |
| 任务很长，先固定当前进度 | **保存阶段并继续** |
| 还要让 Agent 改代码 | **继续修改**或**撤回本次预览** |
| 不需要先查看效果 | **跳过预览并保存** |

dsh-git-worktree README · 安全边界：每次把任务修改写回当前项目之前，插件都会重新确认任务版本、项目位置和文件状态仍与验收时一致。如果你切换了分支、修改发生冲突，或上一次操作意外中断，插件会停止写入并保留现场，而不是猜测后继续覆盖。

Worktree 隔离主要用于避免任务之间误改文件，不是用来运行不受信任代码的系统沙箱。

dsh-git-worktree README · 当前限制：- 只有归属关系明确的任务才会聚合到原项目；无法确认时仍保留原位置，避免任务被隐藏。
- 隔离任务可以重命名和归档，暂不支持从任务对话直接复制出新任务（Fork）。
- 子 Agent 与父任务使用同一个工作目录，不会再为每个子 Agent 创建新的 Worktree。
- 已保存的阶段记录暂不支持编辑、删除、调整顺序或回退到任意阶段。
- [Domi](https://github.com/restflux/domi) 中更完整的跨项目管理、直接修复当前项目、依赖复用和协作交接能力不在本插件当前范围内。

**Let agents complete tasks in independent Git Worktrees, then review the changes before deciding whether to save them.**

dsh-git-worktree README · dsh-git-worktree：`dsh-git-worktree` is a Git Worktree plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness). It creates a separate Worktree (working directory) for each isolated task, where the agent edits and tests code. The plugin writes task changes back to the current project only when you start a preview or confirm saving. When the task is complete, you can preview the result and then save it, send it back for changes, or discard it.

dsh-git-worktree README · dsh-git-worktree：This Git Worktree workflow originated in [Domi](https://github.com/restflux/domi), an open-source desktop coding workbench powered by the Pi Agent Runtime. This plugin is independently adapted for DeepSeek Harness and can be installed and used on its own.

dsh-git-worktree README · Why use it?：When an agent edits the current project directly, its changes can mix with your unfinished work. Running multiple tasks at once can also make them interfere with one another. With this plugin:

dsh-git-worktree README · Highlights：- **Git Worktree isolation**: every task gets its own working directory and its own agent conversation.
- **Run multiple Worktrees**: develop several tasks in parallel; to avoid mixing changes, review one task at a time per project.
- **Preview before committing**: inspect the real result in the current project without immediately creating a Git commit.
- **Send it back safely**: undo the current preview and ask the agent for more changes without disturbing unrelated local work.
- **Save only this task**: confirmation commits only the current task instead of pulling unrelated changes into it.
- **Preserve progress on long tasks**: save the current stage and keep developing; the stages still become one final delivery.
- **Protect the working state**: branch changes, conflicts, and interrupted operations stop safely and leave the state available for recovery.
- **See related tasks together**: current and historical Worktrees are grouped under their Host-provided project navigation owner; ambiguous tasks conservatively remain where they are.
- **Inspect review details in one place**: open a read-only view from the review bar for changed files, vali
dsh-git-worktree README · Highlights：> The current version manages Git Worktrees within one project. It does not yet provide a global cross-project manager.

dsh-git-worktree README · Workflow：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Current project] -->|Create isolated task| B[Independent Git Worktree]
    B --> C[Agent edits and tests]
    C --> D[Review the result]

dsh-git-worktree README · Which action should I choose?：| Goal | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Inspect the result in the current project | **Preview changes** |
| The preview looks correct | **Confirm and save** |
| Preserve progress during a long task | **Save checkpoint and continue** |
| Ask the agent for more edits | **Continue editing** or **Undo this preview** |
| Save without inspecting it first | **Skip preview and save** |

See the [full usage guide](docs/USAGE.en.md) for detailed actions, recovery scenarios, and commands.

dsh-git-worktree README · Install：For the first run, complete one full create → Preview changes → Confirm and save → clean up the Worktree cycle.

dsh-git-worktree README · Upgrades and troubleshooting：- Back up your data and check version compatibility before upgrading Harness. See the [compatibility notes](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md#english) for legacy data migration requirements.
- If the UI shows **Failed to load plugins**, first check that the plugin and Harness versions match, then follow the troubleshooting guide.
- Harness's supply-chain guard (`minimumReleaseAge`) may skip a freshly published release and fall back to an older one. Specify the matching exact version explicitly or retry after the guard window passes.

dsh-git-worktree README · Upgrades and troubleshooting：For Git-source installation, pnpm build approval and other troubleshooting steps, see [Installation and troubleshooting](docs/USAGE.en.md#installation-and-troubleshooting).
dsh-git-worktree README · Prepare the review：See the [full usage guide](docs/USAGE.en.md#complete-delivery-example) for the complete flow.

dsh-git-worktree README · Safety boundary：Before writing task changes back to the current project, the plugin checks again that the task version, project location, and file state still match the review. If you switched branches, changes conflict, or a previous operation was interrupted, it stops and preserves the working state instead of guessing and overwriting files.

Worktree separation is designed to prevent tasks from accidentally changing one another's files. It is not a system sandbox for running untrusted code.

dsh-git-worktree README · Safety boundary：For the detailed state checks and recovery rules, see:

- [Worktree Console architecture](docs/WORKTREE-CONSOLE-ARCHITECTURE.md)

dsh-git-worktree README · Current limitations：- A task is grouped under its original project only when that relationship is clear. Uncertain tasks remain in their original location so they are never hidden.
- Isolated tasks can be renamed and archived, but a new task cannot yet be forked directly from the task conversation.
- Child agents share the parent task's working directory; a separate Worktree is not created for every child agent.
- Saved stage records cannot yet be edited, deleted, reordered, or rolled back to an arbitrary stage.
- The broader cross-project management, direct repair of the current project, dependency reuse, and collaboration handoff features in [Domi](https://github.com/restflux/domi) are outside this plugin's current scope.

dsh-git-worktree README · Language：The plugin follows DSH’s language selection without a separate switch. Explicitly select English in DSH to use English in the UI, tools, and `/worktree` messages. If automatic browser detection has not produced a saved DSH preference, tools and commands fall back to Chinese. See [language transport and translation contributions](docs/i18n.md).
